body.subject: Your order {{orderId}} is confirmed
body.body: Hi {{customerName}}, thanks for your order. We received {{amount}} for "{{service}}". Your receipt is attached and shows the VAT. We will email you the result as soon as the carrier confirms it, usually within a few hours.

body.subject: Your unlock is ready
body.body: Hi {{customerName}}, good news: the carrier confirmed the unlock for {{orderId}}. Insert a SIM from another network and restart the phone. If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

body.subject: We couldn’t unlock order {{orderId}}
body.body: Hi {{customerName}}, the carrier rejected this unlock, so we have refunded {{amount}} to your card. It can take 5 to 10 days to appear. We are sorry it did not work out.

body.subject: Re: Where is my result?
body.body: Hi {{customerName}}, thanks for your patience. We checked with the carrier and… (the text of the agent’s reply). Reply to this email to keep the conversation going.

body.subject: You left something behind
body.body: Hi, you started an unlock for an {{device}} and did not finish paying. Your basket is saved: one tap takes you back to the payment step. No account needed.

body.subject: Your payment didn’t go through
body.body: Hi, the payment for your unlock was declined by your bank, so we did not start it. Nothing was charged. You can try again or use another card.
Order {{orderId}} is complete. The result is in your panel.

body.subject: Your deposit of {{amount}} was approved
body.body: Hi {{customerName}}, your deposit was approved and your wallet is topped up.
